secrets.name: JWT_SECRET
secrets.description: Signing secret for JWT auth tokens. Generate a random string (e.g. openssl rand -hex 32).

secrets.name: SEARCHAPI_KEY
secrets.description: API key for searchapi.io used by the car image search service. Optional — image search won't work without it.

secrets.name: ADMIN_API_KEY
secrets.description: Protects write routes (POST/PUT/DELETE) with an x-admin-key header. Optional — when unset, write routes are open.

secrets.name: KAVENEGAR_API_KEY
secrets.description: Kavenegar SMS API key for sending notifications. Optional — SMS is disabled without it.
